case: Grid context-menu CSV serialization for enum-shaped values
change: The grid CSV serializer now disables ambiguous blank NULL output and chooses a null marker absent from the copied rows.
contract: Literal text NULL, an empty enum label and SQL NULL have distinct CSV fields.
A marker collision with existing values \N and \NN advances to the next unused marker \NNN.
Formula-shaped text remains spreadsheet-sanitized in clipboard output.
Header and headerless context-menu CSV paths use the same serializer contract.
oracle: Exact serialized CSV bytes from the app grid serializer, using a PostgreSQL-qualified enum ColumnInfo and label/NULL values.
scope_limit: Pure serializer proof only. It does not exercise a native PostgreSQL query, OS clipboard delivery, spreadsheet paste/import, or lossless restoration of formula-shaped values.

focused_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --lib clipboard_csv_keeps_null_empty_enum_and_marker_labels_distinct

app_library_suite.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --lib

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --all-targets -- -D warnings

validation.format: rtk proxy cargo fmt --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --all -- --check passed

remaining: Formula sanitization may alter formula-shaped enum labels, as documented for spreadsheet-safe output.
OS clipboard and spreadsheet paste/import acceptance remain unverified.
